post.text:
> open Claude Code
> your .env gets read before you type anything
> your API keys are now in the chat
> your password is now in the chat
> you add "don't read .env" to CLAUDE.md
> doesn't work
> 29 million secrets leaked on GitHub last year
> one line in settings.json actually blocks it
> there's a config that blocks all of this

comments.name: Grok
comments.text:
Here are some solid dev cheat codes to pair with that settings.json block:

- Add a .claudeignore file to keep sensitive folders out of context entirely.
- Prefix prompts with "Project-only mode. No external data." to reduce hallucinations.
- Use Claude's artifacts + "diff only" output for cleaner reviews.
- Enable local MCP tools instead of cloud agents when possible.

Drop your setup if you want more tailored ones. What's the next one you're hunting?
